scenarios.title: free crisis support in the US

summary.reply: Free US crisis options: the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (call or text 988) and Crisis Text Line (text HOME to 741741), both 24/7.

scenarios.title: free emotional support in the UK

summary.reply: In the UK, Samaritans (116 123) is free and open 24/7, and Mind's support line (standard geographic rate) is open weekdays.

scenarios.title: Bengali-speaking free help in India

summary.reply: Free options that serve Bengali speakers: Tele-MANAS, KIRAN (13 languages including Bengali), Vandrevala and the Fortis helplines.

scenarios.title: exam stress support in India

summary.reply: The Fortis Stress Helpline (+91 83768 04102, 24/7, multilingual) specialises in exam stress; Tele-MANAS and KIRAN also help.

scenarios.title: mood-disorder support groups in the US

summary.reply: DBSA runs free peer-led support groups for depression and bipolar disorder, online and in person.
